title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON, delimiter ordering, and token/event ordering
author: Maya Thompson
description: Fixes multiple issues in the SSE streaming surface related to chunking, framing, and partial JSON emission. Motivation: customers and internal tests observed corrupted partial JSON payloads and out-of-order token/event sequences when using the OpenAI compatibility layer under high-concurrency streaming workloads. These bugs caused client JSON parsers to fail or produce invalid structured outputs. This PR stabilizes streaming semantics and adds tests.
commits: fix(sse): introduce BoundaryAwareChunker to avoid splitting JSON tokens across frames
chore(tests): add integration tests for partial-json and delimiter order under load
fix(openai-compat): ensure data: prefix ordering and emit final [DONE] only after all token events and delimiters are flushed
perf(sse): minimize allocations in assembler path and add microbenchmarks
docs(api): add note about streaming guarantees and compatibility improvements
files_snippets: assembler.rs: added a BoundaryAwareChunker that holds a small lookahead buffer and prefers emitting on safe delimiters (newline, comma, brace) to avoid splitting JSON tokens.
framing.rs: reordered event emission path so token events are flushed before control delimiters; added comments describing ordering guarantees.
openai-compat/src/streaming.rs: changed finalization to emit the trailing 'data: [DONE]' line only after the token stream close is observed and all pending delimiters are emitted.
partial_json_stream.rs: new integration test that spawns 50 concurrent streams with varied chunk sizes and asserts reconstructable JSON and stable event ordering.
review_comments: Arjun Patel: Good catch on the assembler races - please add a unit test that reproduces the race window and assert no partial-json occurs.
Maya Thompson: Added race-window unit and integration tests (crates/runtime/tests). The unit test uses a deterministic interleaver to reproduce the old failure locally.
Leah Kim: Can you quantify the latency impact of the boundary-aware approach? We need to ensure we didn't regress the 99th percentile for small payloads.

Maya Thompson: Measured +0.8ms 99p on synthetic microbenchmarks for 128B messages; added microbench results to the PR description and kept the fast-path when boundaries are trivial (single-chunk messages).
Diego Ramirez: One nit: please add a short note in docs/api/streaming.md about the improved ordering guarantees for openai-compat clients.
Maya Thompson: Done - doc note added and linked in the PR description.
ci_summary: benchmarks: recorded (no regression on large-batch throughput)
merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals from Arjun, Leah, and Diego. All CI checks passed. Included tests to cover race reproduction and integration-level load scenarios. Minor perf change documented.
release_notes: Fix streaming SSE framing and partial-JSON emission: resolves cases where clients received malformed/partial JSON when tokens were split across frames. Improves ordering guarantees for token and control events in the OpenAI compatibility streaming layer. Backwards-compatible; no API surface change.
